about: Hand decisions about MSL2 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads this book), and eight text verdicts npcs.py applies. Every one was read off the page image (survey apps/marvel-heroes/docs/surveys/msl2.md, Stat blocks; decisions 6 and 8); none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and a few words of a label - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header, label}: the printed page in the Adventure Book, the whole header as the card prints it and the block's label
verdict   misprint    the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give

text        match {row}: an msh_book_text row key; 'read' a few words as the OCR gives them after folding to ASCII, 'printed' as the page prints them. It must occur once in the row, or npcs.py stops. Applied in this file's order, each to the row as the one before left it.
also      further values of the same block: one override matches one block
checked   the date the page image was read

overrides.note: Printed codes RM IN EX EX IN RM RM over six numbers, 30 40 20 40 30 30, P blank (printed 31): the numbers row lost E's 20, so R, I and P's numbers sit one column left. Restored, every number is its code's standard, Health 110 = 30 + 40 + 20 + 20 and Karma 100 = 40 + 30 + 30, and his human form's grid prints R 40, I 30, P 30 and Karma 100. Survey decision 6. Read on a render 2026-11-02 (plan row 26a).

Nick Fury's IN BRIEF, printed 29: the page prints the commandos' name between double quotes (read on a render 2026-11-02, plan row 26a); the chain paired the two marks as singles, and no card's text prints a single quote (survey decision 8).
Reduced Aging, printed 29, column 1: the page prints World War II (two capital I); the OCR read the second as a lower-case l (220 dpi crop of PDF 31, plan row 27a).

Matter Fluctuation, printed 31, column 1: the first of two bulleted lines; the OCR read the bullet as a letter e before a capital, which no reader rule strips (MX1's bullet_marks needs a lower-case word after it), so the mark is dropped here (220 dpi crop of PDF 33, plan row 27a).

Matter Fluctuation, printed 31, column 1: the page prints a space and a speck, no hyphen, between range and (11 areas), and the second bulleted line's bullet read as a letter e (220 dpi crop of PDF 33, plan row 27a).

Weapons, printed 32, column 2: the first of four bulleted grenades (Flare, Fragmentation, Gas, Smoke), each an italic name with a colon; the bullet read as a letter e. The grenades stay the Weapons power's text, not powers of their own (200 dpi crop of PDF 34, plan row 27a).
Weapons, printed 32, column 2: the second bulleted grenade; the bullet read as a letter e (200 dpi crop of PDF 34, plan row 27a).
Weapons, printed 32, column 2: the fourth bulleted grenade; the bullet read as a letter e (200 dpi crop of PDF 34, plan row 27a).
